title: Flutter Skills
summary: 10 Flutter/Dart development skills covering: architecture best practices (MVVM + Repository pattern), responsive layouts (LayoutBuilder/MediaQuery), layout issue fixes (overflow/unbounded constraints), widget tests (WidgetTester), integration tests (Flutter Driver), widget previews, JSON serialization (fromJson/toJson), declarative routing (go_router), localization (flutter_localizations + intl), and HTTP networking (http package). Skills are installed locally at .claude/skills/flutter/ within the project directory.
